ownership.quote: Heroku, a Salesforce company and industry pioneer in platform as a service (PaaS), enables developers to build and run applications entirely in the cloud.

stage.quote: Salesforce.com Buys Heroku For $212 Million In Cash • TechCrunch
stage.note: Heroku raised VC funding (Baseline Ventures, Y Combinator, Ignition Partners, Ashton Kutcher and others per press coverage of the era) as an independent startup after its W08 YC batch, then was acquired outright by Salesforce.com on Dec 8, 2010 for ~$212M; since then it has operated as a wholly-owned Salesforce subsidiary/product line, so pre-acquisition funding rounds no longer determine its current backing.

total_funding_usd.basis: Crunchbase/press aggregate figure commonly cited for Heroku's pre-acquisition VC raises (seed + Series A/B rounds from Baseline Ventures, Y Combinator, Ignition Partners, Harrison Metal, Ashton Kutcher, New Enterprise Associates) between 2008-2010; no single primary source itemizes the full total, so treated as estimated.
total_funding_usd.quote: Founded: 2007 Batch: Winter 2008 Team Size: 300 Status: Acquired

last_round.quote: Salesforce.com Buys Heroku For $212 Million In Cash • TechCrunch — Dec 08, 2010

note: Founded 2007, went through Y Combinator Winter 2008, acquired by Salesforce.com in December 2010 for ~$212M cash and has operated as a Salesforce subsidiary/product since. In Feb 2026 Heroku announced it is shifting to a maintenance-focused engineering model (security/reliability/support) rather than new features, and Enterprise Account contracts are no longer offered to new customers; existing customers are said to remain unaffected. Free plans were discontinued in Aug 2022 and it suffered a notable OAuth token security breach in April 2022.
